item.title: FICAC will no longer exist if Constitution Amendment Bill is passed
item.description: The Fiji Independent Commission Against Corruption will no longer exist if the Constitution Amendment Bill is passed. FICAC is not included in the proposed Constitution tabled by Prime Minister, Sitiveni Rabuka.
item.content:encoded:
The Fiji Independent Commission Against Corruption will no longer exist if the Constitution Amendment Bill is passed.

FICAC is not included in the proposed Constitution tabled by Prime Minister, Sitiveni Rabuka.

The repeal of the FICAC 2007 is also stated in the Bill.

The Constitution Amendment Bill will be debated on Friday and the third reading of the Bill is expected to take place in 30 days.
